title: 1906 Prairie Avenue — the Edson Keith house built from its engraving
items: Edson Keith's house at 1906 Prairie, a generic draft block until now, stands as the Italianate stone front of its engraving and of the Tribune's 1898 sketch: two storeys over a raised basement under a low hipped roof and a deep bracketed cornice, with round-arched windows under hoods.
A canted bay at the front's south end rises past the cornice as a tower, and a porch on columns at the head of the high stoop carries a balustraded balcony before the arched window over the door.
